title: AI-Based Quantitative Assessment of Retinal Vascular Morphology in Circumscribed Choroidal Hemangioma
problem_type: AI-based retinal vessel quantification; case-control association with circumscribed choroidal hemangioma
real_world_setting: Single centre, Beijing Tongren Hospital (China); retrospective
sample_size: 45 patients (45 CCH eyes + 45 fellow control eyes)
statistical_tests: Paired t-test / Wilcoxon; independent t-test; conditional logistic regression
claimed_novelty: First quantitative AI description of retinal vessel morphology in circumscribed choroidal hemangioma and of how it varies with lesion position.
notes: AI used as measurement tool; no prediction model trained

title: Leveraging ChatGPT for Report Error Audit: An Accuracy-Driven and Cost-Efficient Solution for Ophthalmic Imaging Reports
problem_type: LLM (GPT-4o) error detection in ophthalmic imaging reports; time/cost analysis
real_world_setting: Single centre, Zhejiang University 2nd Affiliated Hospital (China); retrospective + pilot real-world
datasets: Resident-drafted FFA and B-scan reports; real-world pilot set
sample_size: 180 reports (100 FFA, 80 B-scan) + 20 erroneous real-world reports
statistical_tests: Wald chi-square; Wilson 95% CI; paired t-test; Bonferroni; kappa
claimed_novelty: Benchmarks GPT-4o against six human reviewers for catching laterality and anatomical errors in imaging reports and estimates the time and money saved.
notes: GPT-4o vs 2 retina specialists, 2 general ophthalmologists, 2 technicians; clinical utility = time/cost analysis

title: Machine Learning Identifies Predictors of Amniotic Membrane Graft Failure in Neurotrophic Keratitis
problem_type: Risk-factor identification + RF classification of amniotic membrane graft failure in NK
statistical_tests: Chi-square / Fisher; Wilcoxon-Mann-Whitney; multivariable logistic regression; PCA; hierarchical clustering; AUC
claimed_novelty: Combines classical regression, unsupervised clustering and random forests to define risk phenotypes for recurrence after amniotic membrane grafting in neurotrophic keratitis.
notes: Prespecified logistic regression + exploratory RF

title: EVO-ICL Vault Prediction: A Data Wrangling Framework Integrating Multicenter Big Data and Machine Learning
problem_type: Regression and classification of ICL vault from preoperative biometry with a data-wrangling system
statistical_tests: MAE/RMSE/R2; accuracy; mutual information feature ranking
claimed_novelty: Introduces a digital vault information system that restructures multicentre biometry before ML, and shows it improves vault prediction over standard algorithms.
notes: LR, AdaBoost, RF, LightGBM, XGBoost each with/without DVIS (ablation of the wrangling step)

title: Prediction Models for Recurrence of Retinopathy of Prematurity after Intravitreal Ranibizumab or Laser Photocoagulation Treatment: A Multicenter Cohort Study
problem_type: Binary risk prediction of ROP recurrence after IVR or laser
statistical_tests: ANOVA; chi-square; Mann-Whitney; univariate/multivariable logistic regression; AUC with 95% CI
claimed_novelty: Develops tree-ensemble models from systemic neonatal and maternal factors to flag infants likely to need retreatment for ROP.
notes: MLR, RF, XGBoost, CatBoost, AdaBoost; test split is random internal, not a separate centre

title: Peripheral Retinal Vessel Density in Children and Adolescents with Myopia: A Deep Learning Assessment
problem_type: DL vessel segmentation of UWF images + 3-class axial-length classification; association analysis
statistical_tests: Tamhane post hoc; paired t-test; ANCOVA; AUC; Grad-CAM
claimed_novelty: Quantifies peripheral retinal vessel density on ultra-widefield images in myopic children and shows a CNN can sort eyes by axial length from these images.
notes: Nested U-Net (segmentation) + ResNet34 (classification); no comparator model

title: Validation of the Eyerobo FC Portable Fundus Camera for Diabetic Retinopathy Screening Using Public Datasets and Deep Learning
problem_type: Referable DR classification; portable vs desktop camera noninferiority validation of a transferred DL model
real_world_setting: Public datasets + prospective cohort from diabetes clinics (China); device validation
datasets: EyePACS; APTOS 2019 (training); Messidor-2 (benchmark); prospective Eyerobo FC cohort
sample_size: Training 88,702 + 3662 images; Messidor-2 1748 eyes; prospective 104 eyes
statistical_tests: One-sided Z-test noninferiority; bootstrap CIs; Cohen kappa; Bland-Altman; AUC
claimed_novelty: Shows that a DR model trained only on desktop images keeps noninferior sensitivity and specificity when applied unchanged to a new handheld fundus camera.
notes: 2 comparator arms = desktop benchmark vs portable device (single EfficientNet-B4 model); subgroup analysis by image quality

title: Report Generation System for Slit-Lamp Image Interpretation Using Vision-Language Models
problem_type: Slit-lamp image-to-report generation with vision-language models + disease classification
real_world_setting: Two Chinese hospitals (Zhejiang Provincial People's Hospital; Bijie Hospital); retrospective
datasets: Zhaohui Hospital SL dataset (train/internal val); Bijie Hospital dataset (external)
statistical_tests: BLEU/ROUGE-L/CIDEr/SPICE/METEOR; accuracy; Fleiss kappa; ophthalmologist Likert ratings
claimed_novelty: Fine-tunes two open vision-language frameworks to draft slit-lamp reports and checks them on an outside hospital with both text metrics and clinician grading.
notes: LLaVA vs Qwen2.5-VL; no explicitly labelled limitations paragraph found

title: Predicting Postoperative Anterior Chamber Depth, Intraocular Lens Tilt, and Decentration Using an Internally Validated Machine Learning Model
problem_type: Regression of postoperative ACD, IOL tilt and decentration from preoperative SS-OCT biometry
real_world_setting: Single-centre prospective, Kepler University Hospital Linz (Austria)
n_seeds_or_repeats: OOB/bootstrap internal validation; 2:1 split; internal CV for PLS components
statistical_tests: PLS regression (jack-knife 95% CI); random forest OOB error; calibration slope/intercept
claimed_novelty: Builds an internally validated model that forecasts where a specific monofocal IOL will sit (depth, tilt, decentration) from preoperative swept-source biometry.
notes: Abstract vs results sample size discrepancy (49 vs 52)

title: Prognostic Imaging Biomarkers in Diabetic Macular Edema Treated with Anti-VEGF: A Multicenter AI Perspective
problem_type: Prognostic prediction of 12-month morphological/functional response in DME from AI-derived OCT biomarkers
datasets: Pooled 3-centre cohort; RetinAI Discovery OCT biomarker platform
statistical_tests: Shapiro-Wilk; paired t-tests; univariate logistic regression (q-values); random forest feature importance; AUC
claimed_novelty: Uses a commercial AI OCT analyser to show that baseline intraretinal fluid volume and post-loading outer nuclear layer thickness forecast 1-year anatomical response to anti-VEGF in DME.
notes: ML explicitly exploratory; authors note lack of external validation

title: Retinal Vascular Features and Risk of Colorectal Cancer Incidence and Mortality: A Population-Based Cohort Study
problem_type: AI-derived retinal vascular features; survival association with colorectal cancer incidence and mortality
real_world_setting: UK Biobank population cohort (22 assessment centres)
datasets: UK Biobank; RMHAS retinal feature system
statistical_tests: t-test; chi-square; Cox regression (3 adjustment models); PSM; subgroup analyses
claimed_novelty: Links automatically extracted retinal vessel geometry to later colorectal cancer risk and survival in a large population cohort.
notes: Association study (no predictive model); four sensitivity analyses

title: Predictive Modeling of Coronary Artery Disease Using Color Fundus Photography-Based Features of Retinal Vasculature
problem_type: Binary classification of angiography-defined CAD burden from fundus-derived vessel features +/- clinical variables
real_world_setting: Single-centre cardiology department, Vienna (Austria); same-visit fundus photography and coronary angiography
datasets: Single-centre CA cohort; AutoMorph features (Zeiss Clarus 500 CFP)
statistical_tests: AUROC, AP, Brier; bootstrap for model differences; NRI/IDI with bootstrap CI; SHAP
claimed_novelty: First cross-validated ML analysis of explainable fundus vascular features against same-visit coronary angiography, quantifying what they add beyond clinical baselines.
notes: >=7 algorithm families named in text (full list in Fig. 1C); ablation = systematic unimodal vs multimodal feature-set configurations; NRI/IDI, no DCA

title: Machine Learning-Based Prediction of Cycloplegic Refraction Using the Eyerobo Vision Screener: Design—A Cross-Sectional Comparative Device Study
problem_type: Tabular regression (cycloplegic SE, J0, J45) + screening classification at referral thresholds; device comparison
real_world_setting: Single-centre paediatric referral hospital, China; cross-sectional
datasets: Single-centre cohort (Eyerobo VS, auto-refractor, IOLMaster) - 12 feature scenarios
n_seeds_or_repeats: 5-fold grouped CV x 3 seeds; 2000 bootstrap resamples
statistical_tests: Paired bootstrap CI; Wilcoxon signed-rank; Bland-Altman; Pearson; Youden thresholds; AUC
reporting_guideline: none (STARD cited for spectrum bias only)
claimed_novelty: Tests whether a handheld photoscreener plus a tabular foundation model can approximate cycloplegic refraction as well as a desk auto-refractor, and reports triage metrics at clinical referral cut-offs.
notes: TabPFN vs 7 ML algorithms; one-eye-per-patient sensitivity analysis; deployment-factor analysis offline only; non-standard section layout

title: An Agentic AI Workflow for Automated Macular Hole Diagnosis and Structured Report Generation
problem_type: Binary OCT image classification (macular hole vs normal) + LLM structured report generation (agentic workflow)
real_world_setting: Public OCT datasets; UK (Moorfields-affiliated) authors; no prospective clinical deployment
datasets: CHU; OCTDL; OCTID; Kermany (train/val/test); OIMHS; Noor Eye Hospital (external)
sample_size: 2134 images train/val/test (internal test n=180); external 1014 images (563 MH, 451 normal)
statistical_tests: DeLong CIs for AUC; accuracy/sens/spec with 95% CI; Grad-CAM; human rating of 40 reports
claimed_novelty: Chains a fine-tuned retinal foundation model with a language model so that macular hole detection and a patient-readable report come out of one orchestrated pipeline, keeping the diagnosis independent of the LLM.
notes: Fine-tuned RETFound only; no competing model; external sets each contain a single class

title: Reassessment of the Collaborative Normal-Tension Glaucoma Study: Statistical Evidence and Implications for Current Management
problem_type: Methodological re-analysis of RCT survival analysis (CNTGS)
real_world_setting: Secondary re-analysis of published trial reports
statistical_tests: Kaplan-Meier; log-rank; Cox PH (discussed); ITT vs per-protocol comparison
claimed_novelty: Argues that the landmark NTG trial result hinged on post hoc baseline shifting and censoring choices and disappears under intention-to-treat.
notes: Labelled Original Research but is a methodological reappraisal; 0 figures

title: Stereophotographic Assessment of Intraocular Pressure Reduction in Myopic Eyes with Glaucoma-Compatible Optic Neuropathy
problem_type: Structural/functional progression after IOP lowering; self-controlled fellow-eye design
real_world_setting: Single centre, Peking Union Medical College Hospital (China); prospective observational
statistical_tests: t-test / Mann-Whitney; paired t / Wilcoxon; Kaplan-Meier; Cox regression
claimed_novelty: Uses treated versus untreated fellow eyes to argue that glaucoma-like discs in myopia are mostly non-progressive and may not need pressure-lowering therapy.

title: Fast Progressors in Primary Open-Angle Glaucoma: A 5-Year Visual Field Index-Based Classification in a Real-World Cohort
problem_type: VF progression-rate classification (VFI vs MD) and risk factors; longitudinal
real_world_setting: Single centre, Peking University Third Hospital (China); real-world long-term cohort
statistical_tests: t-test / Mann-Whitney; chi-square / Fisher; linear mixed-effects models
claimed_novelty: Compares VFI- and MD-based definitions of fast progression in treated POAG and shows VFI separates progression rates by disease stage.
notes: Separate Limitations section

title: Real-World Data of the First UK Series of MINIject Supraciliary Glaucoma Implant with 6 Months Follow-Up
problem_type: Retrospective real-world device case series (MINIject)
statistical_tests: Linear mixed-effects models
claimed_novelty: First UK real-world series of a supraciliary implant reporting 6-month pressure and medication outcomes.

title: Association Between Preserved Glaucoma Eye Drops Exposure and Glaucoma Surgery Occurrence: A Nationwide 10-Year Outcome Study
problem_type: Nationwide claims cohort: preservative exposure vs glaucoma surgery
statistical_tests: Multivariable Cox regression at multiple horizons
claimed_novelty: Shows a dose-response link between exposure to preserved glaucoma drops and later need for glaucoma surgery across France.

title: Efficacy, Repeatability, and Safety of Retreatment with Micropulse Cyclophotocoagulation in the Management of Glaucoma
problem_type: Retrospective outcomes of laser retreatment by response group
statistical_tests: Tests not named; multivariable logistic regression
claimed_novelty: Characterises which patients benefit from repeating micropulse cyclophotocoagulation, stratified by their response to the first session.

title: Consensual Ophthalmotonic Reaction in Fellow Eyes in the Early Postoperative Period Following Unilateral Glaucoma Surgery
problem_type: Retrospective analysis of fellow-eye IOP response after unilateral surgery
real_world_setting: Single tertiary centre, northern China; retrospective
statistical_tests: Linear mixed model; Spearman; Fisher; t-test; stepwise/multivariable logistic regression; post hoc power
claimed_novelty: Shows that a pressure rise in the fellow eye is common right after any type of unilateral glaucoma surgery and that alpha-2 agonist use protects against it.

title: Prospective Pilot Study of Sustained Release Bimatoprost Implant with SpyGlass Intraocular Lens: 3-Year Results
problem_type: Prospective pilot of drug-eluting IOL system (3 dose arms)
real_world_setting: Single site, Honduras (ethics El Salvador); prospective nonrandomized
statistical_tests: Wilcoxon signed-rank; Kruskal-Wallis; MMRM
claimed_novelty: First-in-human 3-year data for bimatoprost pads mounted on an IOL delivered during routine cataract surgery.

title: Trends in First-Line Glaucoma Treatment from 2013 to 2024: A Multi-institutional and Multinational Cohort Study
problem_type: Temporal trend analysis of first-line treatment (EHR)
real_world_setting: TriNetX global network, 140 HCOs in 21 countries
statistical_tests: Mann-Kendall trend test; FDR (Q value)
claimed_novelty: Tracks 12-year shifts in first-line glaucoma treatment, finding more surgery in open-angle and more medication in angle-closure disease.

title: Safety and Feasibility of the Exchange Procedure for the Travoprost Intracameral Implant for Open-Angle Glaucoma or Ocular Hypertension
problem_type: Single-arm safety trial (implant exchange)
statistical_tests: Descriptive; Wilcoxon signed-rank
claimed_novelty: First evidence that a travoprost intracameral implant can be safely replaced by a new one in the same eye.

title: Comparative Effectiveness of Timolol-Based Fixed-Combination Regimens for Glaucoma: a Retrospective Cohort Study Using Target Trial Emulation Framework
problem_type: Comparative effectiveness via target trial emulation (fixed combinations)
statistical_tests: Propensity overlap weighting; Cox PH; negative control outcome
claimed_novelty: Applies target trial emulation to national claims to show PGA/timolol fails less often than CAI/timolol or alpha-agonist/timolol.

title: Benefit of Latanoprostene Bunod (Vyzulta) for Glaucoma Switched from Prior Pharmacotherapy: A Retrospective Cohort Study in Taiwan
problem_type: Single-arm retrospective switch study (latanoprostene bunod)
statistical_tests: Repeated-measures ANOVA; GEE
claimed_novelty: Reports modest additional pressure lowering after switching Taiwanese patients from standard prostaglandins to latanoprostene bunod.
notes: 3 authors

title: Treatment Persistence with Combination Eye Drops for Glaucoma: A Longitudinal Analysis Using Japanese Medical Claims Data
problem_type: Claims-based treatment persistence analysis
statistical_tests: Kaplan-Meier; Cox regression; descriptive
claimed_novelty: Quantifies how long Japanese patients stay on various combination glaucoma drop regimens in routine care.
notes: Comparators = 5 concomitant-drug groups in RQ1

title: A Multimodal Approach to Open-Angle Glaucoma with Travoprost Intracameral Implant and Minimally Invasive Glaucoma Surgery with or Without Concurrent Cataract Surgery
problem_type: Retrospective case series of combined travoprost implant + MIGS
statistical_tests: Paired t-test
claimed_novelty: Early real-world results for pairing an intracameral travoprost implant with stent or canaloplasty, with or without cataract surgery.
notes: 2 authors

title: Understanding Patient Preferences and Their Impact on Adherence to Glaucoma Therapy: A Multicenter Cross-Sectional Study
problem_type: Cross-sectional patient-preference survey and adherence
statistical_tests: Chi-square
claimed_novelty: Maps what glaucoma patients value in eye-drop format, preservatives and packaging and how this relates to self-reported adherence.

title: Long-Term Effects of Phacoemulsification with Goniosynechialysis in Angle-Closure Glaucoma: A 2-Year Prospective Cohort Study
problem_type: Prospective cohort surgical outcomes and prognostic factors (Phaco-GSL, APACG vs CPACG)
real_world_setting: Single centre, Fudan EENT Hospital Shanghai (China); prospective
statistical_tests: t-test / Mann-Whitney; chi-square / Fisher; Kaplan-Meier; Cox regression
claimed_novelty: Compares 2-year success of phaco-goniosynechialysis between acute and chronic angle closure and identifies preoperative predictors.
notes: Worst-case missing-data sensitivity analysis

title: A Prospective Evaluation of the 2-Year Efficacy and Safety of INTERCIL: A Novel Uveal Spacer for Open-Angle Glaucoma
problem_type: Single-arm device efficacy/safety (supraciliary uveal spacer)
real_world_setting: Single centre, single surgeon, Yerevan (Armenia); prospective
statistical_tests: Descriptive statistics (prespecified)
claimed_novelty: Reports 2-year pressure and medication reductions with a new ab externo uveoscleral spacer that avoids blebs and cyclodialysis clefts.

title: Safety and Efficacy of Microhook Ab Interno Trabeculotomy Combined with Cataract Surgery in Older Patients with Glaucoma
problem_type: Surgical outcomes by age group (microhook trabeculotomy + phaco)
statistical_tests: Kaplan-Meier; log-rank; Cox regression
claimed_novelty: Shows that combined microhook trabeculotomy works as well and as safely in patients aged 76+ as in younger patients.
notes: POAG-only post hoc sensitivity analysis; stated hypothesis

title: Characterizing the Modern Interventional Glaucoma Treatment Paradigm: The Newton Registry
problem_type: Descriptive registry of interventional glaucoma practice patterns
statistical_tests: Descriptive only
claimed_novelty: Describes a new US registry that captures how often and which procedural glaucoma treatments are used in community practice.
notes: 0 figures

title: Multimodal Imaging to Assess Disease Activity and Predict Fluid Resolution in Patients with wAMD Treated with Brolucizumab: The IMAGINE Study
problem_type: Phase IV single-arm trial; early imaging predictors of fluid resolution
statistical_tests: Paired t-test / Wilcoxon signed-rank; McNemar
claimed_novelty: Evaluates whether early multimodal imaging predicts long-term dry macula on brolucizumab, finding no reliable predictor.

title: Predictive Factors of Suboptimal Response to Topical 0.1% Cyclosporine A Cationic Emulsion in Pediatric Vernal Keratoconjunctivitis: A Real-World Retrospective Study
problem_type: Predictors of suboptimal treatment response (Cox + ROC cut-offs)
statistical_tests: Univariate/multivariable Cox regression; ROC; Youden index
claimed_novelty: Identifies baseline severity score cut-offs that signal children with VKC unlikely to respond to cyclosporine cationic emulsion.

title: In Vivo Macro–Micro Neurovascular Mapping and Visual Field Correspondence in Non-Arteritic Anterior Ischemic Optic Neuropathy
problem_type: Structure-function imaging study (NAION) with VF correspondence
statistical_tests: Kruskal-Wallis + Dunn; chi-square / Fisher; t-test; Spearman with FDR; multivariable linear regression
claimed_novelty: Proposes a stage-specific neurovascular framework for NAION by combining widefield OCTA and adaptive optics mapped to visual-field defects.

title: Identification of OCTA Biomarkers and Cutoff Values Associated with Disease Severity in Dry Age-Related Macular Degeneration
problem_type: Cross-sectional OCTA biomarkers and ROC cut-offs for AMD stage
real_world_setting: Single centre, Medical University of Silesia (Poland, per affiliation)
statistical_tests: ANOVA / Kruskal-Wallis + Dunn; ROC
claimed_novelty: Derives OCTA vascular thresholds that distinguish successive dry AMD stages, with choriocapillaris metrics performing best.
